tw-mi-grand-haven-light-house-hill-convi.t: From 1922 Henry Ford's Grand Haven Sand Co. mined the harbour (N/W) end of the dune, 20 cars of sand a day to Detroit; the summit with the water-tank pad survived, which is why the pin sits there.
src: Detroit Evening Times, 22 Aug 1922, p. 2, 'By Ford' (GenealogyBank): Ford buys 'the famous five-mile sand dune'; repeats the treasure tradition

tw-mi-knaggs-bridge-gold.st: The 1906 county history ('Shiawassee's Captain Kidd') adds that the searchers asked after 'a rock in the river known as Indian Rock'; no Indian Rock is named in GNIS, and none is marked at the crossing on the 1875 plat or visible on the 10 m DEM.
src: Past and Present of Shiawassee County (1906), p. 17, 'Shiawassee's Captain Kidd'
